real_result.interpretation: Second-largest causal footprint — knocking out the SLP-76 signalosome adaptor collapses proximal TCR signaling. Together with CD3D this is the internal positive-control pair that shows the ranking recovers TCR biology unsupervised.

io_rationale: SLP-76 cytosolic adaptor that nucleates the TCR signalosome (LAT–SLP-76–PLCγ1/Vav/ITK). KO abrogates proximal TCR signal transduction. Like CD3D, its loss IMPAIRS activation — an accelerator, not a brake — so it is a control, not an enhancement target, despite the large effect size.

tractability.evidence: ChEMBL target CHEMBL6196086 (SH2 + SAM domains); only ~5 PDB structures and 0 drug mechanisms in ChEMBL v34. No small-molecule chemical matter — an undruggable scaffold like RASA2; realistic handle is engineered-cell KO (but KO is deleterious to function here).

genetic_evidence.rationale: No robust common-variant disease-risk GWAS with a usable direction; SLP-76 loss impairs immunity (accelerator, not protective_lof brake). Excluded from the directional funnel (any_gwas=false).

known_drugs.note: No drug mechanisms in ChEMBL v34; intracellular adaptor with no chemical matter.

active_trials.note: Zero direct LCP2/SLP-76-directed trials — undruggable adaptor.

essentiality.note: Immune-restricted but functionally essential for the TCR signalosome; KO removes core proximal signaling.

safety_flags: KO abrogates TCR signaling (activation-defective phenotype). Role here is method validation / positive control, not a therapeutic enhancement KO.
